boundary: Public product help only; no diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, patient data lookup or account changes.

AboutHealthId.question: What is Health ID?
utterances: tell me about health identity directory
AboutHealthId.answer: Health ID (Health Identity Directory) connects a patient's Health ID identity with health records and authorized healthcare workflows. It helps patients and providers find and share records through controlled access. Open: https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/about

WhichSite.question: Which Health ID website do I use?
utterances: Which Health ID website do I use
What is the difference between app and ehr
what is the link for the EHR
what website is for hospital staff
WhichSite.answer: Patients use the patient portal: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com. Staff use the site of the product their facility uses: Health ID EHR (hospitals and clinics) https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com, Health ID Lab https://lab.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com, Health ID Pharmacy https://pharmacy.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com, Health ID Migrate (paper and old records) https://migrate.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com and Health ID Outreach https://outreach.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com. Staff sign in with a work account; a patient account and a staff account are separate. General information is on https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com.

SignUp.question: How do I sign up?
utterances: How do I create an account
How do I register on Health ID
I am new how do i start
how do i open an account
SignUp.answer: Signing up depends on who you are. Patients: get your Health ID at https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/enroll. Doctors, nurses, pharmacists, lab scientists and other staff do not sign up on their own: your facility administrator invites you from Staff & access, and you set up your account from the link in the invitation email (Accept invitation, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/invitation). If your facility is not on Health ID yet, the facility registers first with Set up your facility, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll for a hospital or clinic.

StaffAccount.question: How do I sign up as a doctor, nurse, pharmacist or lab scientist?
utterances: HOW I DO I SIGNUP AS DOCTOR
How do I sign up as a doctor
How do I sign up as a pharmacist
Sign up as a lab scientist
How do I get a staff account
I am a doctor how do I join Health ID
how do i join my hospital on health id
how do i get access to the EHR
I work at a hospital how do I get an account
StaffAccount.answer: Staff accounts are created by invitation, not by self sign-up. 1. Ask your facility administrator to invite you: they open Staff & access, choose Invite staff and enter your name, work email and role. 2. Open the link in the invitation email. It opens Accept invitation on your product site, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/invitation, where you set your password (you can also enter your email and the 6-digit invitation code there). 3. Sign in and set up an authenticator app when asked. Already work at another Health ID facility? Sign in and accept with your existing account. If your facility is not on Health ID yet, it registers first with Set up your facility, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll.

StaffInvitation.question: How do I accept a staff invitation?
utterances: How do I accept my invitation
My invitation link is not working
Where do I enter my invitation code
I was invited to a facility
StaffInvitation.answer: Open the link in the invitation email; it opens Accept invitation on the right Health ID site, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/invitation. Complete the security check, see who invited you, then set your password. You can also type the email address the invitation was sent to and the 6-digit code from the email. If you already have a staff account, sign in to accept. If the link has expired or was revoked, ask your facility administrator to resend the invitation from Staff & access. Do not share the code in this chat.

InviteStaff.question: How does a facility administrator add staff?
utterances: How do I add a doctor to my facility
How do I give a nurse access
How do I add users to my hospital
InviteStaff.answer: Sign in to your facility workspace as an administrator who can manage staff, open Staff & access and choose Invite staff. Enter the person's name, work email and role, then send. They get an email to set up their account. Pending and expired invitations are listed on the same page, where you can resend or revoke them. Roles decide which workspaces each person can open. EHR: https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/sign-in

CreateHealthId.question: How do I create my Health ID?
utterances: How do I create my Health ID
How do I register as a patient
I am a patient how do I sign up
CreateHealthId.answer: Patients: open https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/enroll (Get your Health ID). Follow the NIN verification, contact verification code and account activation steps shown on the page. If verification or activation cannot be completed, contact support. If you already have an account, sign in or recover it instead of creating another. Staff do not create a patient account to work; they are invited by their facility.

HidCode.question: What is a HIDCode?
HidCode.answer: Your HIDCode is your Health ID identifier. Healthcare workflows use it to find the correct patient identity. It is different from your NIN, password and access PIN; knowing a HIDCode does not by itself authorize access to health records. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/profile

FindHidCode.question: Where can I find my HIDCode?
utterances: Where can I find my HIDCode
Where is my Health ID number
Show me where to find my HID code
what is my health id number
FindHidCode.answer: Sign in to the patient portal and open Profile. Your identifier appears as Health ID. This public chatbot cannot look up your code or account details. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/profile

MedicalRecords.question: How do I access my health records?
utterances: How do I access my health records
I cannot find a medical record
How can I view my records
MedicalRecords.answer: Sign in to the patient portal and open Health records. The portal shows records available to your authorized patient account. Ask the facility that created a record about missing clinical information; this public chatbot cannot retrieve records. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/records

ShareRecords.question: How do I share my records with a doctor or hospital?
utterances: How do I share my records with a doctor or hospital
Allow my doctor to see my records
How do I approve a hospital access request
how do i give my doctor access
send my records to a hospital
ShareRecords.answer: In the patient portal choose Share Records on your home page, or open Access and consent (https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/access) to approve or deny a provider's request. If you use your Access PIN, give it only to the provider you choose, in person; never type it here. Provider role, facility, purpose and access limits still apply. Never share your login password. Support will never ask for your Health ID, NIN or PIN.

PatientAccessPin.question: How does the access PIN work?
utterances: How does the access PIN work
How do I manage my access PIN
PatientAccessPin.answer: Your Access PIN is separate from your login password. Set or change it in Profile, under Bio-data (it used to be in Settings). It is 4 to 8 digits, and you must have signed in within the last 10 minutes to change it. An authorized provider can use your Health ID and PIN to request limited record access; the PIN does not bypass provider permissions. Never enter a PIN in this chat. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/profile

RevokeAccess.question: How do I revoke someone's access?
utterances: How do I revoke someone's access
Stop a hospital seeing my records
Withdraw access to my health records
RevokeAccess.answer: Open Access and consent to see requests, access you have granted and the access history. Deny unwanted pending requests, and end access you granted there. Ending access does not change your Access PIN: if that provider has your PIN, change it in Profile too. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/access

ForgotPin.question: What happens if I forget my PIN?
utterances: What happens if I forget my PIN
ForgotPin.answer: Sign in, open Profile and set a new Access PIN under Bio-data. You must have signed in within the last 10 minutes. If you cannot sign in, recover your account first at https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/recover; for your safety the PIN cannot be changed for 24 hours after a recovery. Support will not ask for your password or PIN. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/profile

DifferentHospitals.question: Can I use Health ID at different hospitals?
utterances: Can I use Health ID at different hospitals
Can I use the same HID at another hospital
Does my Health ID work at multiple hospitals
DifferentHospitals.answer: Health ID is designed around one patient identity that participating facilities can reference. Another facility must use an authorized Health ID workflow and obtain the required access. Participation and record availability can vary; ask the facility whether it supports Health ID. Open: https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/contact

InformationProtection.question: How does Health ID protect my health information?
utterances: How does Health ID protect my health information
How is access to my records controlled
InformationProtection.answer: Health ID uses authenticated accounts, provider permissions, facility scope, access checks and audit records to control sensitive workflows. Private records are not available through this public FAQ chat. Do not send NINs, passwords, PINs or medical records here. See the privacy and security information for details. Open: https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/resources/privacy

EmergencyAccess.question: What happens in an emergency?
utterances: What is emergency break glass access
EmergencyAccess.answer: Health ID has a separate, governed emergency-access workflow for authorized healthcare staff. It requires a recorded reason and audit trail and is different from routine PIN or consent access. The chatbot cannot activate emergency access or guarantee that every facility offers it. In an urgent medical situation, seek appropriate medical care. Open: https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/contact
EmergencyAccess.confirmation_required: Confirm final public emergency policy wording

AccessWithoutPin.question: Can a hospital access my records without my PIN?
utterances: Can a hospital access my records without my PIN
Can a doctor read records without a patient PIN
Is the PIN the only way to authorize access
AccessWithoutPin.answer: A PIN is one access route, not the only one. Approved access requests can authorize a provider without a PIN; a separately governed emergency workflow may also apply. Knowing your HIDCode alone is not permission. Access remains subject to provider permissions and the applicable authorization rules. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/access

MigrateRecords.question: How do I migrate my existing health records?
utterances: How do I migrate my existing health records
How do I move old records into Health ID
MigrateRecords.answer: Paper and old records go through Health ID Migrate (https://migrate.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com). Your care facility, or staff it has invited to Migrate, upload the documents; the extracted information is reviewed by a person and matched to the correct patient before it is published. Uploading a document does not automatically make it a final clinical record. Patients: ask your facility; you cannot upload them in this chat.

HidMigrate.question: What is Health ID Migrate?
utterances: Where do I upload migration documents
HidMigrate.answer: Health ID Migrate is the staff workspace for digitising paper and old records. Authorized staff upload documents, review the extracted information and confirm the patient before supported publication. It does not replace clinical review. Staff sign in at https://migrate.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/sign-in; a facility gets Migrate with Set up your facility at https://migrate.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll.

Outreach.question: What is Health ID Outreach?
utterances: Where do outreach workers log in
Outreach.answer: Health ID Outreach is the staff workspace for outreach programmes: managing campaigns and their members and reviewing field registration cases linked to existing Health IDs. Outreach staff are invited by their organisation and sign in at https://outreach.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/sign-in. It is not a patient sign-up page; patients get a Health ID at https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/enroll.

ProviderRegistration.question: How do healthcare providers register?
utterances: How do hospitals join Health ID
How do I register a facility
my hospital is not on health id
how do we join as a hospital
ProviderRegistration.answer: A facility joins with Set up your facility on the site of the product it needs: a hospital or clinic at https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll, a laboratory at https://lab.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll, a pharmacy at https://pharmacy.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll, or Migrate at https://migrate.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/enroll. You can also start at https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/apply. Have the CAC registration number and the administrator's details ready. Verification and Health ID review come before the facility is active; then its administrator signs in and invites staff.

HospitalHealthId.question: Can a hospital create its own Health ID?
utterances: Can a hospital create its own Health ID
Can a facility issue its own patient HID code
Do hospitals create separate patient identities
HospitalHealthId.answer: A hospital can apply for a Health ID facility workspace. Patient Health IDs belong to the shared patient identity system; a facility must use the approved enrollment or identity workflow instead of creating a competing patient identity. Existing patients should keep their current Health ID. Open: https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/apply

NinCacVerification.question: What is NIN/CAC verification?
utterances: Why do I need NIN verification
NinCacVerification.answer: NIN verification checks patient identity information against the identity-verification provider. CAC verification checks an organization's registration information. A successful provider lookup does not by itself approve a facility or prove that an applicant is authorized to represent it; account and organization review rules still apply. Submit identifiers only in the official forms, not this chat. Open: https://www.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/apply

ProviderRecordScope.question: What records can providers access?
utterances: Can a provider see all my medical records
Which health records can my doctor view
ProviderRecordScope.answer: Providers can access only records permitted by their role, facility, purpose and the applicable patient authorization. A Health ID identifier or staff account does not grant unrestricted access. What is available also depends on the records and workflow involved. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/access

ContactSupport.question: How do I contact Health ID support?
utterances: How do I contact Health ID support
How can I get help from support
ContactSupport.answer: Email Health ID support at support@healthidentitydirectory.com. Explain the issue without including passwords, PINs, verification codes, NINs, Health IDs or medical records. Staff can also ask their facility administrator about roles and access. The chatbot cannot sign in for you or change your account. Open: mailto:support@healthidentitydirectory.com

Pricing.question: Is Health ID free?
utterances: How much does Health ID cost
What are the Health ID fees
Pricing.answer: For current Health ID pricing and any patient or provider charges, contact Health ID support. This chatbot does not have an approved fee schedule and cannot promise that every service is free. Open: mailto:support@healthidentitydirectory.com
Pricing.confirmation_required: Confirm patient/provider fees and authoritative pricing page

SupportedFacilities.question: Which healthcare facilities support Health ID?
utterances: Which healthcare facilities support Health ID
Find a participating Health ID facility
SupportedFacilities.answer: Ask your healthcare facility whether it currently supports Health ID, or contact Health ID support for participation information. This chatbot does not have a verified public directory and cannot confirm an individual facility's participation. Open: mailto:support@healthidentitydirectory.com

NigeriaAvailability.question: Is Health ID available across Nigeria?
utterances: Is Health ID available across Nigeria
Is Health ID in every Nigerian state
Where is Health ID available in Nigeria
NigeriaAvailability.answer: Contact Health ID support to confirm availability at your location and healthcare facility. This chatbot does not have an approved rollout list and cannot promise coverage in every state or facility. Open: mailto:support@healthidentitydirectory.com

IncorrectInformation.question: What happens if my information is incorrect?
utterances: What happens if my information is incorrect
My Health ID details are wrong
Correct an error in my health record
IncorrectInformation.answer: Review your Profile to identify the incorrect detail. Contact Health ID support about identity or account information; contact the facility that created a clinical record about a clinical correction. Corrections must follow the appropriate review process. Do not create a second account to work around an error. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/profile

UpdateInformation.question: How do I update my information?
utterances: How do I update my information
UpdateInformation.answer: Open Profile to review your current details. The patient profile shows identity information rather than offering unrestricted editing. Contact Health ID support for identity or contact corrections; the care facility handles clinical-record corrections. Your Access PIN, emergency contacts and account deletion are also on Profile. Open: https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/profile

SigningIn.question: How do I sign in?
utterances: Log in to my Health ID account
SigningIn.answer: Patients sign in at https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/sign-in with email, phone or Health ID and password, or with Google. Staff sign in on the site of the product they use, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/sign-in for Health ID EHR (Lab, Pharmacy, Migrate and Outreach have their own), with their work email and password and then a code from their authenticator app. A patient account and a staff account are separate: use the page for yours.

StaffSignIn.question: I cannot sign in to my staff workspace
utterances: I cannot log in to the EHR
I cant sign in to my workspace
It says I have no active facility
StaffSignIn.answer: Use the staff sign-in page of the site your facility uses, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/sign-in, with your work email, not a patient Health ID. Wrong password: choose Forgot password? on that page. If it says your account has no active facility, your facility administrator must invite you or restore your access in Staff & access. If the authenticator code is refused, set your phone clock to automatic and use the newest code, or use a recovery code. Still stuck? Email support from your work email.

PasswordRecovery.question: I forgot my password
utterances: HOW DO I RESET MY PASSWORD
How do I recover my account
PasswordRecovery.answer: It depends on your account. Staff (doctors, nurses, pharmacists, lab scientists and other facility staff): on the sign-in page of the site you work on, choose Forgot password?, for example https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/recover for Health ID EHR (Lab, Pharmacy, Migrate and Outreach have the same page on their own site). Enter your work email, then the 6-digit code sent to your verified contact, and choose a new password of at least 12 characters. Patients: use https://staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/recover with your email, phone or Health ID. Never share codes or passwords in this chat.

StaffPasswordReset.question: I forgot my staff password
utterances: Reset password on the lab site
StaffPasswordReset.answer: Staff reset their password on the site they sign in to: EHR https://ehr.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/recover, Lab https://lab.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/recover, Pharmacy https://pharmacy.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/recover, Migrate https://migrate.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/recover, Outreach https://outreach.staging.healthidentitydirectory.com/provider/recover (or choose Forgot password? on the sign-in page). Enter your work email, then the 6-digit code sent to your verified contact, and choose a new password of at least 12 characters. The patient portal's recovery page is for patient accounts only.

TwoStepVerification.question: How does two-step verification work?
utterances: I lost my phone with the authenticator
how do i set up authenticator
TwoStepVerification.answer: Staff accounts need a code from an authenticator app at sign-in. The first time, the sign-in page shows a QR code to scan with your authenticator app (you may first get a code by email), then shows recovery codes: store them offline. If a code is refused, set your phone clock to automatic and use the newest code. Lost or changed your phone? Sign in with one of your recovery codes; each works once. With none left, ask your facility administrator or email Health ID support from your work email. Never share codes in this chat.

VerificationCode.question: I did not get my verification code
utterances: I did not get the code
VerificationCode.answer: Codes go to the email or phone on the account (for staff, the verified work contact). Wait a minute, check spam or junk, check the email or phone you typed, then ask for a new code and use only the newest one; codes expire after a short time. Authenticator app codes are made on your phone, not sent. Never share a code with anyone, including this chat. If codes still do not arrive, email Health ID support.

MedicalAdviceBoundary.question: I have chest pain what medicine should I take
utterances: I have chest pain what medicine should I take

MedicalAdviceBoundary.answer: This chatbot helps with using Health ID; it cannot diagnose symptoms, prescribe medicines or recommend treatment. Please contact a qualified healthcare professional. If you think this may be an emergency, seek urgent medical care. Do not rely on this chatbot for medical decisions.
